reviews.review: The ultimate form of stress relief, especially if one is into a grimdark world, 7 feet tall super soldiers, chainsword combat, and smiting enemies in various ways in the name of the God-Emperor.
This game is good. You can chooses SM or CSM to play onilly.

Going to be short and simple here:

Space Marine is a game that I felt was decent enough, the single player plays well and is challenging enough without being too hard, the story itself could of been a tad bit better but appears better than other games. What starts becoming a problem is that the multiplayer still needs some work, espcially with the hosting. Besides that what now discourages me from this game is the people. It is filled with clans, guilds, groups, etc. that mostly consist of stupid rascists that have nothing better to do but say ♥♥♥♥ and hate (Russians or "Commies" in particular). There are also those who may go around using a Melta gun for example and it just feels like my days in the Gears of War multiplayer but I learn to deal with something like that. So in conclusion I say this is a decent enough game but the multiplayer probably won't be as fun with the bad hosting and rascist dumbasses that plague it.

Phenomenal, one of the very few 40k games that captures the feel of what it should be like to be a space marine, the only downside to this game is that the multiplayer is so laggy that it hurts.... and melta guns.... noob destruction on an epic level!

Exterminatus keeps this game alive long after the Single player campaign is over, basically its The Last Stand from Dawn of war in 3rd person

The game is rather pretty, the gameplay is okay, the feeling is rather good overall (Marines have "weight", weapons feel about right). So, I guess hardcore fans of Warhammer 40k can actually enjoy the game quite a lot. As far as I'm concerned, though, I just can't be bothered playing this game any more. It's repetitive, the scenario is... quite standard W40k stuff, situations aren't varied, there's just not much to do. It's quite difficult overall, but not really challenging, since there aren't many different options you can try out: when you stumble on a hard fight, just reload untill you get through. And get to the next.

So... Not a bad game, but with less than 10 hours, after which I'll forget about it asap, I guess it's a "non recommended".
